column5: Wrist-worn cuffless blood pressure device (clinical trials) + Evie Ring (smart ring)
column6: Cuffless BP prototype uses RF/millimeter-wave sensors requiring consistent wrist placement for PPG-based blood pressure estimation through the radial artery. Proper band fit and sensor alignment critical for accuracy — loose fit degrades signal quality.
